deterministic.error_definition: incorrect deterministic argmax prediction is positive

mc_dropout.prediction: argmax of the mean probability across stochastic passes
mc_dropout.error_definition: incorrect MC-averaged argmax prediction is positive
mc_dropout.pairing_note: MC scores use MC-averaged predictions and therefore do not share exactly the same error set as deterministic scores.

boundary_proximity_detection.positive_definition: frame lies within the stated inclusive time window of a ground-truth phase boundary

calibration.method: one positive scalar temperature per training seed
calibration.input: original raw deterministic logits saved by the validation-selected checkpoint
calibration.objective: pooled per-second multiclass negative log likelihood
calibration.rq2_effect: none; calibrated probabilities are diagnostic and do not replace the probabilities or thresholds used by rq2_proposed_gate_v1

test_exposure_note: The test split had already been inspected during iterative method development. Test summaries under this configuration are reproducibility and consistency evidence, not a fully independent confirmatory test.

ood.reason: Excluded from the current project scope by the project owner.
